# scc_classification_grading_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing ClassificationGradingPolicy object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `end_date_time` (String) Maps to the -EndDateTime parameter.
- `grader_id` (String) Maps to the -GraderId parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `sensitive_information_type_ids` (Set of String) Maps to the -SensitiveInformationTypeIds parameter.
- `start_date_time` (String) Maps to the -StartDateTime parameter.
